title: HydroJet Dolphin Cruise

services.name: Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Labor Day special on September 6, then every Saturday in October - the best seat in Destin Harbor for the fireworks show is on the water. Destin Harbor hosts fireworks shows throughout the season, and there's no better seat than on the water. The HydroJet Fireworks Cruise takes you to the perfect viewing position - close enough to feel the show, far enough to see the full display light up the night sky. This cruise has its own energy. The crew cranks the music, the harbor comes alive, and the vibe on board is pure party. You'll be dancing before the first firework goes up. Whether you're celebrating Labor Day weekend, enjoying a fall Saturday in Destin, or just making the most of your trip

services.name: Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Destin's most popular water adventure - 1 hour on the Gulf, searching for dolphins and soaking up the emerald coast. The HydroJet Dolphin Cruise is a 1-hour open-water adventure along Destin's stunning emerald coastline. You'll depart from 314 Harbor Blvd and head out into the Gulf, cruising past the famous Crab Island and scanning the water for dolphins and other marine life. The HydroJet is unlike any other boat in Destin - a custom-built vessel that combines the thrill of a jet-ski with the capacity of a tour boat. services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Book the world's largest jet-ski exclusively for your group. Perfect for parties, corporate events, family gatherings, and any occasion worth celebrating on the water. A private HydroJet charter means the entire boat, all 29 seats, belongs to your group for the duration of your cruise. No strangers, no shared schedule. Just your people, the open Gulf, and an experience that's completely yours. Our crew will work with you to customize the experience. Departure time, route preferences, and any special touches that make your event memorable.
